repos.description: Turn Claude Code into a full game dev studio — 49 AI agents, 75 workflow skills, and a complete coordination system mirroring real studio hierarchy.
repos.summary_zh: 该项目将Claude Code转变为完整的游戏开发工作室，包含48个专业化AI智能体、37个工作流程和8个自动化钩子。通过模拟真实游戏公司的三层管理架构（总监-部门主管-专员），为独立开发者提供结构化的团队协作体验。核心价值在于建立质量关卡、设计评审和标准化流程，确保从创意到发布的全程规范性，同时保持人类决策权。
repos.summary_en: This project transforms Claude Code into a complete game development studio with 48 specialized AI agents, 37 workflow commands, and 8 automation hooks. It mirrors real studio hierarchy across three tiers (Directors, Department Leads, Specialists) using Anthropic's Opus/Sonnet/Haiku models. The system provides structured team collaboration for solo developers, featuring quality gates, design reviews, and enforced coding standards. It maintains human decision-making while adding automated validation, sprint planning, and documentation generation throughout the development lifecycle from brainstorming to launch.

repos.description: 🤖 A minimal and customizable Docker image running the Android emulator as a service.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供基于Alpine的最小化Docker镜像，用于将Android模拟器作为服务运行。支持KVM硬件加速和GPU加速（CUDA），可自定义Android版本与设备类型，内置ADB端口转发，兼容scrcpy远程控屏。专为CI/CD农场设计，提供无头运行模式，镜像体积可压缩至138MB（不含SDK），适用于自动化测试与远程Android开发场景。
repos.summary_en: Repository provides a minimal Alpine-based Docker image that runs Android emulator as a service. Features KVM hardware acceleration and GPU support (CUDA), customizable Android versions/device types, built-in ADB port forwarding, and scrcpy compatibility for remote screen control. Designed for headless CI/CD farms, the image can be compressed to 138MB (SDK-free variant). Ideal for automated testing and remote Android development with optimized performance and network accessibility.

repos.description: 一款专注于 AI 多模态翻译的工具，一键自动翻译 RPG/SLG 游戏、Epub/TXT 小说、PDF/Word/MD 文档、Srt/Ass/Vtt 字幕，以及漫画图片、音频与视频等内容。
repos.summary_zh: AiNiee 是一款专注于复杂长文本 AI 翻译的工具，支持游戏、电子书、文档、字幕等全格式一键翻译。采用思维链翻译、上下文关联和 AI 术语表技术突破长文本翻译局限，深度适配 Mtool、Renpy 等游戏提取工具，提供术语提取、AI 润色等质量控制功能，实现高效高质量的多领域翻译。
repos.summary_en: AiNiee is an AI-powered translation tool specialized in complex long-text translation across games, ebooks, documents, and subtitles. It employs chain-of-thought translation, contextual association, and AI glossary to overcome long-text limitations. With deep integration of game extraction tools like Mtool and Renpy, it offers terminology extraction and AI polishing features for efficient, high-quality multilingual translation.

repos.description: Open-source compatibility layer for Diablo II: Resurrected with the Reign of the Warlock expansion. Runs your own Switch copy natively on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android and HarmonyOS — full touch controls, 60 fps, new endgame modes. Bring your own game files. 开源的《暗黑破坏神 II：狱火重生》术士君临 iOS / macOS / 安卓 / 鸿蒙兼容层
repos.summary_zh: 开源的《暗黑破坏神 II：狱火重生》iOS/macOS 兼容层，将 Switch 版游戏原生移植至 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac。基于 aarch64 原生执行与 Metal 图形重实现，支持术士君临扩展、完整触控操作、60fps 流畅运行，用户自备游戏文件即可离线畅玩。
repos.summary_en: Open-source iOS/macOS compatibility layer for Diablo II: Resurrected with Reign of the Warlock. Runs the Switch build natively on Apple devices via aarch64 execution and Metal graphics reimplementation, with full touch controls and 60 fps.

repos.description: Curated tools, case studies and papers for reverse engineering websites, games, apps, binaries, firmware and protocols. Source-reviewed, English and Chinese.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库汇集了网站、游戏、应用、二进制、固件和协议等六大领域的逆向工程工具、案例与论文，共5000余项资源，均经来源审查，支持中英双语，为安全研究、漏洞挖掘和软件分析提供一站式导航。
repos.summary_en: This repository curates tools, case studies, and papers for reverse engineering websites, games, apps, binaries, firmware, and protocols. With over 5,000 resources, all source-reviewed and bilingual, it serves as a comprehensive hub for security research, vulnerability discovery, and software analysis.

repos.description: Open Source Clones of Popular Games
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个开源游戏克隆数据库网站，聚合各类经典游戏的开源复刻版本信息。采用YAML管理游戏数据，Python构建静态站点，支持Docker一键部署。开发者可通过PR或Issue提交游戏条目，GitHub Actions实现自动化构建部署。为游戏开发者提供学习参考和项目发现平台。
repos.summary_en: This is an open-source game clones database website that aggregates information about open-source reimplementations of popular classic games. It uses YAML files for structured game data management, Python for static site generation, and supports Docker deployment. Developers can contribute new game entries via pull requests or GitHub issues, with GitHub Actions automating the build and deployment workflow. The platform serves as a valuable resource for game developers to discover open-source projects, reference implementations, and learn from existing game clones.

repos.description: Render Anything Engine: tell your AI what to make. Videos, motion graphics, 3D and games as React and TypeScript, rendered on your own GPU. Rust + Bevy, macOS, Linux and Windows.
repos.summary_zh: raea 是面向 AI 的渲染引擎，用自然语言描述需求，以 React/TypeScript 编写，在本地 GPU 渲染视频、动态图形、3D 和游戏。基于 Rust+Bevy，跨平台支持 macOS/Linux/Windows。
repos.summary_en: raea is an AI-oriented rendering engine that lets you describe what to make in natural language, written as React and TypeScript, and rendered on your local GPU for videos, motion graphics, 3D, and games. Built with Rust and Bevy, it supports macOS, Linux, and Windows. It provides a desktop app and CLI tools, integrates with AI agents like Claude Code, and can render frames, play live as a game, export standalone programs, and check quality issues such as clipped text or low contrast. Designed for AI-driven content creation, it enables anyone to generate professional-grade visuals quickly.

repos.description: A vector graphics application for structured SVG editing, available on all major desktop platforms and on web. Currently in late alpha.
repos.summary_zh: GodSVG 是一款结构化 SVG 编辑器，直接操作 SVG 源码而非添加元数据，实现 UI 与代码实时双向同步。生成干净、精确、优化的矢量文件，适合设计师与开发者对图形进行像素级控制。支持桌面与 Web 平台，目前处于晚期 alpha 阶段，强调低抽象工作流。
repos.summary_en: GodSVG is a structured SVG editor that fundamentally differs from traditional tools by directly manipulating SVG source code without metadata overhead. It enables real-time bidirectional sync between visual editing and code view, producing clean, precise, and highly optimized vector files. Designed for designers and developers requiring pixel-perfect control, it runs on desktop and web platforms in late alpha stage.

repos.description: An isometric world‑builder set in Tolkien’s Middle‑earth, where you create and shape your own landscapes inspired by its iconic lands and lore.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个基于托尔金中土世界的等距地图构建工具，支持7大种族领地和混合模式。采用Next.js 16、React 19和TypeScript 5技术栈，提供3x3至20x20的网格编辑、6类地形瓦片、角色叠加和拖拽绘制功能。支持PNG/JSON导入导出、撤销操作、本地存储和社区地图共享。适用于游戏原型设计、粉丝创作和地理可视化场景，具备深度链接加载和瓦片回退机制。
repos.summary_en: An isometric map builder set in Tolkien's Middle-earth featuring 7 distinct realms and mixed-mode support. Built with Next.js 16, React 19, and TypeScript 5, it offers grid-based editing (3x3 to 20x20), 6 tile categories, character overlays, and click/drag painting. Key features include PNG/JSON import/export, undo support, Zustand-powered localStorage persistence, and community collections. Ideal for game prototyping, fan creations, and geographic visualization, with deep-link loading and automatic tile fallback mechanisms.

repos.summary_zh: 为独立游戏开发者提供AI动画转精灵图的生产级管线。通过FFmpeg帧提取、自动去背景、智能打包成256x256标准格式，内置浏览器审查工具与AI助手集成，实现从AI生成视频到游戏可用资源的可控生产流程，确保仅审核通过的资产进入项目。
repos.summary_en: Provides indie game developers with a production-grade pipeline for converting AI-generated animations into sprite sheets. It extracts frames via FFmpeg, performs automatic matting, packs assets into standardized 256x256 formats, and includes a browser-based review tool with AI assistant integration, ensuring only approved outputs are promoted to game projects.

repos.description: LinPad — Linux for iPad. A real Linux desktop on the iPad: native windowed desktop with tiling and workspaces, real Linux apps (Firefox, VS Code, Thunar, VLC) as native windows, ARM64 JIT, GPU via Venus/Metal, keyboard + trackpad + touch.
repos.summary_zh: LinPad 将 iPad 变身真实 Linux 桌面，基于 Alpine Linux 与 Wayland 合成器，原生运行 VS Code、Firefox、VLC 等应用，支持窗口平铺、工作区、ARM64 JIT 及 Venus/Metal GPU 加速，无需虚拟机或越狱，一个应用解锁 iPad 完整生产力。
repos.summary_en: LinPad transforms iPad into a real Linux desktop powered by Alpine Linux and Wayland, running native apps like VS Code, Firefox, and VLC with window tiling, workspaces, ARM64 JIT, and Venus/Metal GPU acceleration—no VM or jailbreak needed.

repos.summary_zh: Sprite Lab是一款纯浏览器端工具，专为图像背景去除与精灵图自动切割设计。无需上传或AI模型，利用Canvas API实现多通道alpha抠图消除边缘光晕，并通过连通像素扫描智能检测帧。支持动画预览、帧排除及ZIP导出（含manifest），全部本地处理，保障隐私与离线可用。适用于2D游戏开发和动画资产准备。
repos.summary_en: Sprite Lab is a fully client-side web tool for automatic background removal and spritesheet slicing. Using only the HTML Canvas API, it detects backdrops like green screens or checkerboards and applies multi-pass alpha matting to eliminate edge halos. Connected pixel analysis enables intelligent frame detection without grids. Features include animation previews, frame exclusion, and ZIP exports with manifests. Everything runs locally with no uploads, AI, or servers—ideal for 2D game asset preparation.
